claim: On Standard brokers you can optionally enable provisioned storage throughput for storage volumes; this additional storage throughput is charged by the amount you provision in MB/s per month.

evidence.quote: On Standard brokers, you will provision storage and optionally enable provisioned storage throughput for storage volumes, which can be used to scale I/O without having to provision additional brokers.
You also have the option to provision additional storage throughput independently, charged by the amount you provision in MB/s per month.
